reason: Tata Motors is launching a voluntary all-cash tender offer for Iveco Group, committing significant capital to acquire a European commercial-vehicle maker with cyclical earnings and integration risk.
why_now: Exchange filings dated 2026-09-05 announce the recommended offer; the market can now price the deal terms and financing.
